football_evidence.question: Can UNLV’s pass rush get to Air Force’s quarterback?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward Air Force, and its own breakdown accounts for about 1.7 of the 2.9 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.
supporting: When Air Force has the ball (big plays through the air): Air Force’s offense turns 19.5% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and UNLV’s defense gives up explosive gains on 11.3% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.4%).

When Air Force has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Air Force’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 9.5% of its runs, and UNLV’s defense stops 18.1% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).

When UNLV has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): UNLV’s offense has allowed a sack on 8.7% of its dropbacks, and Air Force’s defense sacks the quarterback on 6.3% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Air Force’s offense No. 57 nationally and UNLV’s No. 101.
contradicting: When Air Force has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Air Force’s offense has allowed a sack on 18.4% of its dropbacks, and UNLV’s defense sacks the quarterback on 6.8% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).
When Air Force has the ball (the red zone): Air Force’s offense succeeds on 48.4% of its red-zone plays, and UNLV’s defense allows success on 28.3% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.8%).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put UNLV’s offensive line No. 27 nationally and Air Force’s No. 89.
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put UNLV’s secondary No. 54 nationally and Air Force’s No. 135.
quarterbacks: Liam Szarka has completed 19 of 40 passes (47.5%) for 296 yards, 7.4 yards per attempt, 1 touchdown and 4 interceptions in four games for Air Force, and has been sacked on 2 of 42 dropbacks.
Jackson Arnold has completed 86 of 151 passes (57.0%) for 1,135 yards, 7.5 yards per attempt, 7 touchdowns and 1 interception in six games for UNLV, and has been sacked on 15 of 166 dropbacks.
